'''Qin Yukun''' ({{zh|c=秦裕琨|p=Qín Yùkūn}}; 30 May 1933 – 13 November 2023) was a Chinese engineer who was a professor at [[Harbin Institute of Technology]], and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]].

==Biography==
Qin was born in [[Shanghai]], on 30 May 1933, while his [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] in [[Yangzhou]], [[Jiangsu]].<ref name="Qin">{{cite news  |url=https://ishare.ifeng.com/c/s/v002q2moPnqtfwyAFLLzhKOGRBI5vOEJm-_hL--8kyne10OHA__ |script-title=zh:中国热能工程领域的先行者与奠基人秦裕琨逝世，系哈工大“八百壮士”代表 |work=thepaper |date=13 November 2023 |access-date=10 February 2024 |language=zh}}</ref><ref name="Shi">{{cite news |author1=Zhang Shiying ({{lang|zh|张士英}}) |url=https://www.workercn.cn/364/201906/05/190605090352017.shtml |script-title=zh:秦裕琨：他的报国心历久弥坚 |work=workercn.cn |date=5 June 2019 |access-date=10 February 2024 |language=zh}}</ref> In 1949, he was accepted to the Department of Mechanical Engineering,  Jiaotong University, where he graduated in 1953.<ref name="Qin"/><ref name="Shi"/> In July of that same year, he entered the graduate class of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, [[Harbin Institute of Technology]] and also participated in the establishment of the Department of Boiler (later changed to Department of Thermal Energy Engineering).<ref name="Qin"/><ref name="Shi"/>

After university in 1956, he stayed for teaching.<ref name="Qin"/><ref name="Shi"/> He was an assistant in September 1956, lecturer in September 1961, associate professor in September 1978, and eventually professor in May 1985.<ref name="Qin"/> He joined the [[Chinese Communist Party]] (CCP) in November 1981.<ref name="Qin"/> He was made director and party branch secretary of the Department of Power Engineering in March 1987 and subsequently dean in May 1990.<ref name="Qin"/> He rose to become vice president of the institute in October 1990.<ref name="Qin"/>

On 13 November 2023, he died of an illness in [[Harbin]], [[Heilongjiang]], at the age of 90.<ref>{{cite news |author1=Li Liyun ({{lang|zh|李丽云}}) |url=http://www.stdaily.com/index/kejixinwen/202311/d3e39dca1c4244559032c052d4cdef2c.shtml |script-title=zh:“燃烧自己温暖大家”！痛别秦裕琨院士 |work=stdaily.com |date=13 November 2023 |access-date=10 February 2024 |language=zh }}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* 1985 State Science and Technology Progress Award (Third Class) for the development of a 130t/h fluidized bed boiler for power generation.
* 2000 State Technological Invention Award (Second Class) for the risk controlled combustion technology for thick and thin coal powder.
* 2001 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]] (CAE)
* 2015 State Technological Invention Award (Second Class) for the high performance center feeding swirl coal powder combustion technology.
